scope: Capability classification only — does this domain's data shape support each capability, not whether the capability is built today. Grain: the 18 top-level domains of schemas/name-entity.schema.json, not individual leaf fields (216 leaf-level cells was judged too granular to be useful; domain-level judgments are stated with rationale where non-obvious).

capabilityDefinitions.pageRendering: Can back visible content on a rendered page.
capabilityDefinitions.search: Can be indexed/matched against a user's search query.
capabilityDefinitions.filters: Can back a filter/facet control (e.g. 'names from India').
capabilityDefinitions.recommendations: Can feed a 'you might also like' style recommendation.
capabilityDefinitions.aiAnswers: Can support a direct-answer / FAQ / conversational-AI response with a real citable fact.
capabilityDefinitions.internalLinking: Can generate a link to another page/entity.
capabilityDefinitions.comparisonEngine: Can feed the cross-country/cross-name comparison feature.
capabilityDefinitions.siblingEngine: Can feed the sibling-harmony scoring feature.
capabilityDefinitions.analytics: Can be aggregated/trended for site analytics.
capabilityDefinitions.futureApi: Could be exposed via a future public/partner API.
capabilityDefinitions.multilingual: Can be translated/localized without losing meaning.

domains.note: Universal — every other domain depends on identity for linking/keying. multilingual is partial because slug/name are Latin-script by default; a translated display name is a variants/transliterations concern, not identity's own.
multilingual: no because category/style vocabularies (traditional, biblical, ...) are English labels with no current translation layer.
The domain with the single highest aiAnswers value on the site (per audit/knowledge-roi.json, the field with the most rendered fallback occurrences today).
The field ranked #1 by audit/knowledge-roi.json — also the field with the widest capability footprint of any domain in this matrix.
comparisonEngine/siblingEngine: no because neither current feature scores on language independent of origin.
New domain — capability assessment is prospective, based on the field shapes defined in schemas/name-entity.schema.json, since no live data exists yet.
internalLinking: partial — notableBearers[] could link to other content in a future capability, not today.
comparisonEngine: yes because regionalNotes conceptually overlaps today's per-country-pair cultural-context prose (generate-compare-pages.js getCulturalContext()).
Confirmed absent from the site entirely (audit/entity-map.json, Phase 1A) — this row is fully prospective.
Derived/computed from popularity, not independently researched — see audit/knowledge-domains.json.

siblingEngine: yes — phonetic rhythm is already one of the 5 real sibling-harmony scoring factors (audit/assertion-catalog.json). 0% populated today (audit/knowledge-coverage.json) despite this broad capability footprint.
search: yes — alternate-spelling lookup is a real, high-value search capability this domain already supports at ~100% coverage.
The domain behind today's highest-page-count feature (Names Like X, 3,697 pages) — recommendations and internalLinking are its primary existing use.
comparisonEngine and analytics are this domain's primary today; both are constrained by the field's 0.14% coverage (audit/knowledge-coverage.json), not by any capability limitation.
Entirely computed (x-provenance: computed on every leaf field in the schema) — the only domain with zero researched leaf fields.

aiAnswers: yes — citations are specifically the trust/provenance signal that distinguishes a real answer from the current generic 'Sources and Etymology' fallback block (audit/fallback-taxonomy.json).
pageRendering: partial — lastUpdated backs freshness signals already used sitewide via scripts/build-date.js and aeo-article-schema.js.
